definition: teaching given as a series of lessons
description: A group workout on a park lawn at golden hour, big trees behind and low sun flaring through the leaves. A woman in a grey crop top stands at the front with both arms stretched overhead, hands clasped, leaning to one side, and half a dozen people in gym clothes behind her copy the move. They drop into deep kneeling lunges with a hand on the front knee, then all jump on the spot swinging their arms up over their heads, then settle into wide side lunges with both arms held straight out, everyone moving together.
transcript: That's the spot. Mmm, that feels good. So good.

taps.target: the man in the blue vest
